name: BlurReveal
description: Text fades in from a heavy blur into sharp focus.

name: StaggeredFadeUp
description: Words rise from below with a soft cascading delay.

name: MaskedSlideReveal
description: Lines grow out from behind an invisible horizontal mask.

name: TrackingIn
description: Letter-spacing collapses from wide to normal with a spring snap.

name: InlineHighlight
description: Animates one word inside a sentence from a base color to a brand color.

name: MarkerHighlight
description: Marker bar sweeps in behind a phrase, optionally inverting the text color.

name: ShimmerSweep
description: Bright gradient sweeps across dim text, lighting it up.

name: Typewriter
description: Character-by-character text reveal with a deterministic blinking cursor.

name: TextFadeReplace
description: Cross-fades between two strings on the same line. Includes a StrikethroughReplace variant.

name: SlotMachineRoll
description: Numbers and characters roll into place like a casino reel.

name: InfiniteMarquee
description: Endlessly scrolling horizontal text band.

name: PerspectiveMarquee
description: Marquee tilted into 3D space with depth fade.

name: MatrixDecode
description: Random characters scramble and resolve into the target string.

name: RGBGlitchText
description: Three-channel RGB split with a brief horizontal jitter.

name: SpringPopIn
description: Elastic scale pop with configurable overshoot.

name: PulsingIndicator
description: Continuous sine-driven pulse for loading or activity states.

name: SuccessConfetti
description: Deterministic particle burst from a chosen origin point.

name: CursorFlow
description: Realistic mouse that arcs along Bezier paths and clicks targets that dip in response. Includes a SimulatedCursor variant.

name: BrushStrokeSimulator
description: A simulated fingertip drags a blur brush across an image, revealing a pixelated overlay along its trail via SVG mask.

name: BoundingBoxSelector
description: Figma-style selection rectangle that snaps around a target.

name: ToastNotification
description: System toast that springs in, holds, and slides away.

name: MeshGradientBg
description: Living gradient where soft color blobs drift on noise-driven coordinates.

name: DynamicGrid
description: Subtle moving grid or dot pattern background.

name: SpotlightCard
description: Cursor-tracked radial light that rims a card and lifts it from the dark.

name: GlassCodeBlock
description: Premium frosted-glass code window with rim light and traffic-light controls.

name: TerminalSimulator
description: CLI build simulation with chunked log output and step-function scrolling.

name: CodeAccordion
description: Long code blocks collapse mid-section, hiding noise behind a count badge.

name: CodeDiffWipe
description: Before/after comparison with a clip-path slider revealing the new code.

name: StaggeredBentoGrid
description: Bento grid where cards cascade in with per-cell sequences.

name: ChatToPreviewLayout
description: Two-column split where one panel shrinks and the other expands into view.

name: AIGenerateOverlay
description: AI 'thinking' overlay — source blurs under a shimmering dot grid while a glassy pill pulses, then the new image fades in.

name: ToolMenuSlideIn
description: A horizontal pill of tool icons whips up from below the canvas, then each icon pops in with a staggered spring.

name: AnimatedLineChart
description: SVG line chart drawn left-to-right via stroke-dashoffset.

name: AnimatedBarChart
description: Bars spring up from the baseline with deterministic stagger.

name: DragAndDropFlow
description: Cursor drags a file into a drop zone that lights up and starts a progress bar.

name: ZoomThroughTransition
description: Aggressive scale-in 'through' an element to the next scene.

name: DeviceMockupZoom
description: Pull back from a UI to reveal it inside a phone or laptop frame.

name: MorphingModal
description: Card lifts off a grid and expands into a full-screen modal.

name: ImageExpandToFullscreen
description: A thumbnail in a feed post lifts off the card and morphs seamlessly into a fullscreen editor.

name: DirectionalWipe
description: Slide one scene in while pushing the other out.

name: SwipeTransitionWipe
description: A mobile-style swipe transition with parallax background and a darkening trail on the outgoing scene.

name: SpatialPush
description: A new scene physically presses the old one back into the frame.

name: FrostedGlassWipe
description: Elegant scene transition through a sliding pane of frosted glass.

name: GridPixelateWipe
description: Dissolve from one scene to the next through a deterministic grid of mask cells.

name: ChromaticAberrationWipe
description: An ultra-fast slide transition with an RGB glitch on the peak frames.

name: HeroDeviceAssemble
description: Floating device layers spring into a laptop or phone, then the screen wakes with a shimmer.

name: EcosystemConstellation
description: Central logo orbited by integration satellites with pulsing data lines.

name: InfiniteBentoPan
description: Camera diagonally drifts across an oversized bento grid behind a soft vignette.

name: BrowserFlow
description: Full Safari/Chrome simulation: URL typing, loading bar, scroll, and click.

name: AIGenerationCanvas
description: Prompt input morphs into a header, then a skeleton dashboard flips into populated cards.

name: LiveCodeCompilation
description: Split-screen where typed code on the left snaps a live UI preview on the right.

name: TerminalToBrowserDeploy
description: CLI deploy completes, terminal blurs back, and a browser window springs from the deploy URL.

name: DashboardPopulate
description: Empty dashboard cascades to life with KPI count-ups, bar bounces, line traces, and a donut fill.

name: PipelineJourney
description: Kanban ticket flies between columns, triggering events on landing.

name: PricingTierFocus
description: Three pricing cards where the focused tier rises and brightens while siblings dim and blur.

name: ProductLaunchTrailer
description: Cinematic Product Hunt teaser with logo pulse, zoom-through, 3D bento fly-over, and a confetti version drop.

name: ChangelogBite
description: Seamlessly looping square card showing a before/after diff with a frosted glass wipe and a pulsing New pill.

name: VisualDocsSnippet
description: Calm tutorial flow — virtual cursor arcs to a button, clicks, and a bounding box plus tooltip explain what happened.
